\begin{proposition}\label{prop:5.1}
% Prop5.1.\
\(\pi^{2}_{3}=\gen{\eta_2}\cong\mathbb Z,\quad
\pi^{n}_{n+1}=\gen{\eta_n}\cong\mathbb Z_2\ (n\ge3),\quad
(G_1;2)=\gen{\eta}\cong\mathbb Z_2.\) \\
ここで, 
\(H(\eta_2)=\iota_3,\ \Delta(\iota_5)=\pm 2\,\eta_2\) が成り立つ. 
\end{proposition}
